category_title: Children with communication difficulties and reactive behavioral outbursts
scenario_title: Reacting to peer disagreement during group discussions
minimal_context: Angus is participating in a group discussion about the story Laura and Paul where students must raise their hands to contribute.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start our group discussion about the story Laura and Paul. Remember to raise your hand if you wish to contribute.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand and speaks very quickly) I know what happened! Once that thought is in your head it’s a brilliant thing. It’s a brilliant thought!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you. Sarah just mentioned that she disagrees with your view on the story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks flustered) But... no! Wait, I lost what I was going to say. She's wrong!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you want to say back to her?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes an angry face and shouts out) Shut up! (Kicks the desk) I'm not talking to you!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's start our group discussion about the story Laura and Paul. Remember to raise your hand if you wish to contribute.

TUTOR: Thank you. Sarah just mentioned that she disagrees with your view on the story.

STUDENT: (Looks flustered) But... no! Wait, I lost what I was going to say. She's wrong!

TUTOR: What do you want to say back to her?

STUDENT: (Makes an angry face and shouts out) Shut up! (Kicks the desk) I'm not talking to you!

task.content: Engaging in class discussions using the story Laura and Paul (McCall, 2006) as their stimulus.

context.social_setting: Group dialogue where participants must raise their hand should they wish to contribute

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When they say things he does not like or that disagree with his views.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He shouts out in class and makes faces at others or kicks them... having violent outbursts at those who disagreed with him.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Upset when he is not coping.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Becomes over-excited and flustered... struggles to express himself.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Loses track of the conversation and becomes frustrated.
related_quotes: Once that thought is in your head it’s a brilliant thing. It’s a brilliant thought
